name: Real shock episodes, category attribution and external audit
episode_rule: consecutive detected months within the same total series and the same direction
category_alignment: municipality name is used only if it maps to exactly one complete series in each of all six categories
category_normalization: robust z inside category x 2023-size-quintile x month
category_attribution_time: all five component categories are evaluated only at aggregate episode peak_month
strong_category_rule: at peak_month, raw surprise and robust z have episode direction and abs(z) >= 2
priority_score: mean percentile rank of peak score ratio, absolute surprise magnitude and episode duration; triage only

external_validation.selection: first 10 episodes by frozen priority_rank; selected before external source review
external_validation.protocol: manual grouped audit of frozen TOP-10 using independent public sources; no live retrieval inside notebook

news_alignment.forecast_origin_rule: verified publication_date <= origin; exclude retrospective audit

causality_note: category attribution and external evidence are descriptive associations and do not establish causality
